items.headline: Pennysia Exploit: Users Told to Revoke Approvals Now
items.summary: Pennysia suffered an exploit draining four addresses, with SlowMist urging users to revoke approvals. Swaps were disabled before the public warning went out.

items.headline: $OM Shock: MANTRA Freezes New Unstaking for 7 Days
items.summary: MANTRA announced a seven-day pause on new unstaking requests, filed under hacks. Tokens already unstaking keep their eight-day countdown, but new withdrawals are blocked.

items.headline: $DYDX Proposes Moving USDC Backing to Injective
items.summary: The $DYDX v9.9 plan would shift USDC backing from Noble to Injective, rerouting deposits and withdrawals while leaving balances, collateral and open positions untouched.

items.headline: $ONDO Backs Spout's No-Interest Stock-Token Loans
items.summary: Ondo is backing Spout's plan for zero-interest loans against stock tokens on Solana, funding lender returns with covered calls. Borrowers take on forgone gains and liquidation risk.

items.headline: $1INCH Delegators Must Claim Rewards by Nov. 27
items.summary: 1inch closed new resolver delegations and warned existing delegators to claim rewards and undelegate before Nov. 27. Plain $1INCH staking is unaffected.
